item.summary: Union Minister for Road Transport and Highways, Shri Nitin Gadkari, today addressed the gathering at ‘RIDE – MOVING INDIA FORWARD’ at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi. Organised in collaboration with Uber, Ola, Rapido, Bharat Taxi, Zomato, Swiggy and Porter, the programme brought together industry representatives, drivers, gig workers and beneficiaries to highlight the contribution of app-based…
item.title: Union Minister Shri Nitin Gadkari highlights role of app-based platforms in employment generation and inclusive mobility
